It boasts a high durability and is strong enough to beat down powerful foes.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 36 |durability = 16 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Dragonbone Boko Bat}} Dragonbon Boko Bats are [[Boko Bat]]s that have been reinforced with fossilized bone. As a result, they are stronger and more durable than before. They belong to the [[Bokoblin Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of Weapons created and used by [[Bokoblin]]s.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} They are often wielded by [[Black Bokoblin]]s, [[Silver Bokoblin]]s, and [[Golden Bokoblin]]s, as well as [[Black Moblin]]s, [[Silver Moblin]]s, and [[Golden Moblin]]s. Dragonbon Boko Bats are common on [[Hyrule Ridge]] and along the [[Necluda Sea]]. The {{BotW|-}} Series Bokoblin [[amiibo]] has a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Dragonbone Boko Bat when it is scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. Being made of wood, Dragonbon Boko Bats will burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They will also float when dropped on the [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they will not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]].
